integrity: Exact integer enumeration after a proved finite reduction; two different deterministic verifiers completed. Mathematical review is not independent.
scientific_limitations: The lower bound concerns odd squarefree strongly pseudoperfect integers only, not odd numbers with prime powers or the least value of an example. The witness 937365 and the modulus-four obstruction appeared in earlier work. Originality is supported by targeted searches and source comparisons but cannot exclude all unindexed prior calculations.
title: Six is the least prime-support size for odd squarefree strongly pseudoperfect integers
